def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1)
    upper, lower = grid[:sep], grid[sep + 1:]
    # Sparse marks above select matching-color cells in the lower pattern.
    bg = max(set(sum(lower, [])), key=lambda x: sum(v == x for row in lower for v in row))
    target = min(set(sum(lower, [])), key=lambda x: sum(v == x for row in lower for v in row))
    marker = max(set(sum(upper, [])), key=lambda x: sum(v == x for row in upper for v in row))
    upper_bg = max(set(sum(upper, [])), key=lambda x: sum(v == x for row in upper for v in row))
    # The sparse upper color is the less frequent one; use it to locate overlaps.
    marker = min(set(sum(upper, [])), key=lambda x: sum(v == x for row in upper for v in row))
    out = [[bg] * w for _ in lower]
    for r in range(min(len(upper), len(lower))):
        for c in range(w):
            if upper[r][c] == marker and lower[r][c] == target:
                out[r][c] = 3

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1)
    top = grid[:sep]
    bottom = grid[sep + 1:]
    # The panels share a color; mark cells where that shared color overlaps.
    shared = set(v for row in top for v in row) & set(v for row in bottom for v in row)
    color = next(iter(shared))
    out = [[color] * w for _ in range(min(len(top), len(bottom)))]
    for r in range(len(out)):
        for c in range(w):
            if top[r][c] == color and bottom[r][c] == color:
                out[r][c] = 3
    return out
